decision.reason: [ev-96b59d041e80] is a one-line release note: "Added stats tags configuration for watchdog metrics." It says something was added, but it does not name the setting (Helm value, MeshConfig/ProxyConfig field, bootstrap template or annotation), the component involved (Envoy proxy bootstrap or istiod), or any default. So the open aspects, subject and applicability, cannot be written as a typed assertion. Settling them needs the linked PR or diff for note 52743, or documentation that names the setting and says whether it applies by default.
